name: S.C.Short
source:
A small short story set in New Amsterdam about Tara playing with a new toy.

Tara takes a nice late night stroll along the beach. What fun could she find and what new toys to play with?...

[Edited from [url=https://blackweb-games.itch.io/scshort]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一则以新阿姆斯特丹为舞台，讲述塔拉玩弄新玩具的短篇故事。

深夜，塔拉惬意地沿着海滩散步。她会找到什么乐子，又有什么新玩具可以玩呢？…
